description: This file defines the Currency class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling currency data, formatting, conversion, and retrieval functions.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Handles currency data, formatting, conversion, and retrieval within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Currency object, loads currency data from the database.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string with symbols and decimal places.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a currency value from one currency to another.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a specified currency.

methods.name: getSymbolLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the left symbol of a specified currency.

methods.name: getSymbolRight
methods.description: Retrieves the right symbol of a specified currency.

methods.name: getDecimalPlace
methods.description: Retrieves the decimal places used for a specified currency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value/exchange rate of a specified currency.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a currency exists in the loaded currency data.
